description: This file defines the IdSpan struct, a primitive type for representing a sequence of bytes as an identity, including methods for creation, comparison, serialization, and formatting.

classes.name: IdSpan
classes.description: A readonly struct representing a sequence of bytes used as an identity, with methods for equality, comparison, serialization, and string formatting.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new IdSpan instance from a string by encoding it as UTF8 bytes.

methods.name: AsSpan
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySpan<byte> over the underlying byte array.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another IdSpan instance.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the stored hash code of the IdSpan.

methods.name: GetUniformHashCode
methods.description: Returns a stable, unsigned hash code for the IdSpan.

methods.name: UnsafeCreate
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan with a specified byte array and hash code, intended for low-level use.

methods.name: UnsafeGetArray
methods.description: Retrieves the underlying byte array from an IdSpan instance.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this IdSpan with another for ordering.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a UTF8 string representation of the byte sequence.

methods.name: TryFormat
methods.description: Attempts to format the IdSpan as a string into a provided character span.
